title: Two-Line Layup Warm-Up
description: A classic pre-practice warm-up: two lines feed each other for easy layups to get shots going and bodies moving before drills begin.

content.objective: Get easy, controlled makes while the team gets loose.
content.setup: One line starts at the left wing with a ball, the other at the right block without one.
instructions: The wing passes ahead to the cutter stepping toward the basket.
The cutter finishes a layup off the backboard.
Both players rotate to the opposite line after their touch.
Keep a steady rhythm — one group should never wait long for the other.
coachingPoints: Lead the pass to where the cutter is going, not where they are.
Finish with the foot opposite the shooting hand.
Jog back into line with purpose, not a stroll.
commonMistakes: Passing too early or too hard for an easy finish.
Lines bunching up at one basket.
Rushing through the movements instead of using the full range of motion.
content.safety: Keep the landing area under the rim clear before the next pair starts.
